name: FFA/ToC Cup and Belt
epitaph: The prize of an eight-woman one-night tournament announced for 1 June 2002, to be worn for a year alongside a hundred thousand dollars. The tournament was never staged and the belt was never awarded.

name: Heidi Leick Hardcore Cup
epitaph: A hardcore trophy named for the wrestler who was to referee it, open to the wrestlers eliminated from the Super 8 and to three entrants who asked for it alone. It was never contested.

name: FFA/ToC Tag Cup
epitaph: The prize of a seven-team tables, ladders and chairs elimination match announced for 1 June 2002. Applications closed on 28 April 2002 and the match was never staged.
